ProgramUnit.Name: LOC_CHECK_ELIGIBILITY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE loc_check_eligibility (
 p_donor_id IN varchar2,
 p_procedure_code IN varchar2,
 p_donation_type IN varchar2,
 p_coll_date IN date,
 p_elig_status OUT varchar2,
 p_deff_date OUT Date,
 p_inter_type OUT varchar2,
 p_reason OUT varchar2)
IS
 ddr_count NUMBER;
 longest_span NUMBER;
 temp_count NUMBER;
 temp_donats NUMBER;
 temp_days NUMBER;
 temp_eligible VARCHAR2(1);

 CURSOR c1 (cdate in date) IS /* too soon check */
 SELECT max(coll_date + days_between) next_elig_date
 FROM DONATIONS don, VALID_ELIG_PROCS vep
 WHERE don.donor_id = p_donor_id and
 (don.coll_date between( trunc(cdate) - longest_span ) and trunc(cdate) ) and
 don.procedure_code = vep.prev_procedure_code and
 vep.curr_donation_type = p_donation_type and
 vep.procedure_code = p_procedure_code and
 ( sysdate between vep.eff_date and nvl(vep.term_date,sysdate+1) ) ;

 CURSOR c2 (cdate in date) IS /* too many check */
 SELECT coll_date, vep.days_between, vep.max_donations
 FROM DONATIONS don, VALID_ELIG_PERIODS vep
 WHERE don.donor_id = p_donor_id and
 --don.procedure_code = p_procedure_code and
 (don.coll_date between( trunc(cdate) - vep.days_between ) and trunc(cdate) ) and
 vep.procedure_group IN ( Select procedure_group 
 from valid_proc_groups 
 where procedure_code = p_procedure_code ) and
 vep.curr_donation_type = p_donation_type
 ORDER BY days_between;

BEGIN
 Begin /* DDR HIT CHECK */
 ddr_count := 0;
 Select count(*) into ddr_count 
 from donor_deferral_registry
 where center_id = p_donor_id;
 if ddr_count > 0 then
 p_elig_status := 'N';
 p_deff_date := NULL;
 p_inter_type := 'PERMD';
 p_reason := 'Permanently Deferred, Entry in Central DDR.';
 return;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 null;
 end; 

-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Begin /* Inter_type is HOLDS, Local Hit in donor_interdiction */
 ddr_count := 0;
 Select count(*) into ddr_count
 from donor_interdictions
 where (donor_id = p_donor_id) and
 (nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) > sysdate) and
 inter_type = 'HOLDS';

 --message('Count is :'||to_char(ddr_count));pause;
 if ddr_count > 0 then
 p_elig_status := 'N';
 p_deff_date := NULL;
 p_inter_type := 'HOLDS';
 p_reason := 'Donor is on Hold.';
 return ;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then 
 null;
 End;
 Begin /* Local perm def in donor_interdiction */
 ddr_count := 0;
 Select count(*) into ddr_count
 from donor_interdictions di, valid_interdictions vi
 where (donor_id = p_donor_id) and
 di.inter_code = vi.inter_code and
 vi.deferral_flag = 'Y' and
 vi.period_type = 'P'; 
 --message('Count is :'||to_char(ddr_count));pause;
 if ddr_count > 0 then
 p_elig_status := 'N';
 p_deff_date := NULL;
 p_inter_type := 'PERMD';
 p_reason := 'Donor is Perm deferred, entry in Local DDR.';
 return ;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then 
 null;
 End;
 Begin /* Local temp. deferred Hit in donor_interdiction */
 ddr_count := 0;
 Select count(*) into ddr_count
 from donor_interdictions di, valid_interdictions vi
 where (donor_id = p_donor_id) and
 di.inter_code = vi.inter_code and
 vi.deferral_flag = 'Y' and
 (nvl(di.term_date,sysdate+1) > sysdate );
 
 --message('Count is :'||to_char(ddr_count));pause;
 if ddr_count > 0 then
 p_elig_status := 'N';
 p_deff_date := NULL;
 p_inter_type := 'TEMPD';
 p_reason := 'Donor is Temp deferred, entry in Local DDR.';
 return ;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then 
 null;
 End;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

 temp_eligible := 'Y';
 Begin
 Select max(days_between) into longest_span 
 from valid_elig_procs
 where curr_donation_type = p_donation_type and
 procedure_code = p_procedure_code and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date , sysdate+1);
 --message('LONGEST SPAN To CHECK (in DAYS):'||to_char(longest_span));
 --pause;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --message('No data for the Given procedure_code and donation type.');
 --pause;
 p_reason := 'Err. No data found in Longest span query.';
 when others then
 --message('When others error : for longest span query.');
 --pause;
 p_reason := 'Err. in Longest span query.';
 End;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 /* TOO SOON CHECK */
 FOR c1_rec IN c1(p_coll_date) LOOP
 if (c1_rec.next_elig_date > p_coll_date ) then
 temp_eligible := 'N';
 p_inter_type := 'TEMPD';
 p_deff_date := c1_rec.next_elig_date + 1;
 p_reason := 'Attempting to donate too soon.';
 end if;
 END LOOP;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 /* TOO MANY CHECK */
 Begin
 temp_donats := 0;
 temp_count := 0;
 temp_days := 0;
 FOR c2_rec IN c2(p_coll_date) LOOP
 if(temp_days = 0) then
 temp_days := c2_rec.days_between ;
 temp_donats := c2_rec.max_donations;
 end if;
 if(c2_rec.days_between = temp_days ) and
 (c2_rec.max_donations = temp_donats ) then
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 if (temp_count > c2_rec.max_donations ) and
 (c2_rec.coll_date + c2_rec.days_between) > p_coll_date then
 temp_eligible := 'N';
 p_deff_date := c2_rec.coll_date + c2_rec.days_between + 1;
 p_inter_type := 'TEMPD';
 p_reason := 'Too many times for this procedure.';
 end if;
 else
 temp_count := 1;
 temp_donats := c2_rec.max_donations;
 temp_days := c2_rec.days_between;
 end if;
 END LOOP;
 End;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 p_elig_status := temp_eligible;
 
END;
